# Security Policy

Please report vulnerabilities privately. Do not open a public issue.

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/TyrusRC/limes/security) of the TyrusRC/limes repository.
2. Click "Report a vulnerability" to open a private GitHub Security Advisory.
3. Include steps to reproduce, impact, and any suggested fix.

The maintainer (TyrusRC) will review reports as soon as possible. Please allow time to
investigate and fix before disclosing publicly.
